content: संयुज् I. €7 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To join together, connect, unite. .²2 To endow or furnish with. .²3 To form an alliance. .²4 To place or fix in, set in. --II. €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> To unite; संयुज्यन्ते वियुज्यन्ते तथा कालेन देहिनः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 15. 3</ls>. --{%<ab>pass.</ab>%} .²1 To be united with; संयोक्ष्यसे स्वेन वपुर्महिम्ना <ls>R. 5. 55</ls>. .²2 To be married to; यादृग्गुणेन भर्त्रा स्त्री संयुज्येत यथाविधि <ls>Ms. 9. 22</ls>. .²3 To have sexual intercourse. .²4 To be supplied or furnished with. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To unite, join; संयोजयति विद्यैव नीचगापि नरं सरित् <ls>H. 1</ls>. .²2 To harness, yoke. .²3 To prepare, equip (an army). .²4 To furnish, endow or supply with, provide with; बुद्ध्या संयोजयन्ति तम् <ls>Pt. 2</ls>. .²5 To fasten or fix on. .²6 To throw, discharge, shoot (a missile). .²7 To use, employ. .²8 To appoint (to an office), entrust with. .²9 To perform, accomplish. .²10 To be absorbed in, meditate upon.

संयुज् {%a.%} .²1 Connected, relating to; संयुजा च सह मेदिनीपतिम् <ls>Śi. 14. 55</ls>. .²2 Possessed of or endowed with good qualities. .{@-जा@} Union, connection; न पारयेऽहं निरवद्यसंयुजाम् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 33. 22</ls>.
